text: Assalam-o-alaikum. Yeh hai SIGIL — aik AI brand identity studio. Yeh koi logo generator nahi hai. Yeh aik poora design process hai, jahan har faisla aap karte hain.
Discovery se le kar final brand package tak — pooray das stages. AI kaam karta hai, lekin creative control aap ke paas rehta hai.
Chaliye aik asli client ke saath shuru karte hain. Meeras Estates — Lahore ki aik property firm.
Pehla field: company ka naam. Bilkul wahi spelling likhein jo final logo pe aani hai.
Doosra field: industry. Main likh raha hoon — verified-title residential plots.
Aur yahan company ki kahani. Do bhaiyon ne dou hazaar gyara mein yeh firm banai, jab un ki apni khandani zameen jaali kaghzaat pe chali gayi. Ab har plot pehle title verification se guzarta hai.
Yahan koi lamba form nahi hai. AI aap se interview karta hai — bilkul jaise aik senior designer client se karta hai.
Audience kaun hai? Pehli baar plot khareedne wali families, aur overseas Pakistani jo khud kaghaz check nahi kar sakte.
Brand dekh kar kya mehsoos hona chahiye? Sukoon. Ke kisi ne aakhir-kaar papers theek se check kar liye.
Personality ke paanch lafz — trustworthy, meticulous, rooted, protective, aur unflashy.
Aur muqabla kis se hai — baray property portals aur local commission dealers.
Ab dekhiye kamaal. AI ne jawab parh kar khud naye sawal bana diye — logo kahan use hoga, signboards pe ya legal documents pe. Yeh fixed form nahi hai, yeh sochta hai.
Jab AI ke paas kaafi maloomat ho jaye, tab hum brand brief likhwate hain.
Yeh raha brand brief. Positioning, audience, personality — aur sab se important, Avoid section.
Yahan AI ne khud likh diya ke kin cheezon se bachna hai — skyline, glass tower, ghar ka outline, chaabi. Yani real estate ke ghisay-pitay clichés.
Aur har field editable hai. Yeh AI ka faisla nahi — yeh aap ka document hai.
Aur jab tak aap approve nahi karte, aage kuch bhi generate nahi hota. Yeh pehla human gate hai.
Ab AI aath creative territories banata hai. Yeh logo nahi hain — yeh alag alag ideas hain. Abhi tak koi artwork nahi bana.
Har territory ke saath strengths aur risks likhe hain. AI apni kamzoriyan khud bata deta hai.
Do approve, aur aik reject. Yeh rejection yaad rakhi jati hai, aage har generation us territory se bachegi.
Ab asli logo banenge. Har approved territory ke andar alag alag concepts — sirf rang badal kar nahi, poori construction alag.
Aik click, aur poora batch chal parta hai. Aap pause kar sakte hain, cancel kar sakte hain, ya sirf failed wale dobara chala sakte hain.
Aur yeh raha nateeja. Har mark ka apna naam hai, apna idea hai.
Yahan se insaan ka kaam shuru hota hai. Favourite, shortlist, reject. AI faisla nahi karta — aap karte hain.
Aur agar raye chahiye, to AI critic asli artwork dekh kar batata hai — chhote size pe kya hoga, embroidery mein kya hoga. Yeh tareef nahi karta, masle batata hai.
Aur yeh asli test hai — bina rang ke mark kaam karta hai ya nahi.
Ab feedback dijiye, apne alfaaz mein. Main keh raha hoon — symbol theek hai, lekin wordmark halka lag raha hai.
AI is ko design instructions mein badal deta hai — kya rakhna hai, kya badalna hai, kya hatana hai. Aur yeh aap confirm karte hain, generate hone se pehle.
Har variation apne parent concept se juda rehta hai, is liye design history kabhi tootti nahi.
Sab se strong concept finalist banta hai — aur phir us ka poora lockup family: symbol, wordmark, horizontal, monochrome, aur reversed.
Client ko dikhane ke liye bilkul alag presentation mode hai. Aur teen alag approvals — aap ki, client ki, aur final.
Teenon approvals alag alag record hoti hain. Project sirf tab finalize hota hai jab final approval di jaye.
Aur aakhir mein brand kit — colour palette, typography, clear space, aur minimum size.
Aur SIGIL saaf saaf batata hai: yeh files AI raster hain, production vector nahi. Jhoot nahi bolta.
Aur yeh hai woh jo client dekhta hai. Saaf, simple — na prompts, na rejected concepts, na aap ke private notes. Sirf kaam.
Yeh tha SIGIL. Discovery se delivery tak — AI ki raftaar, aur insaan ka faisla. Dekhne ka shukriya.
